root_cause.defect: CvUnitAI::AI_settlerSeaTransport recognised escorts with canDefend(); with no plot argument CvUnit::canDefend tests the unit's own plot, and a land unit aboard a ship at sea fails isValidDomainForAction (LAND_UNITS_CAN_ATTACK_WATER_CITIES is 0)
root_cause.symptom: after the first leg the ship logged MISSING_ESCORT_OR_CAPACITY each turn and skipped on the water tile next to the site
root_cause.second_defect: CvUnit::setXY moves each disembarking cargo unit into a new group, so the landed settler and escort were split and lost MISSIONAI_FOUND
root_cause.why_tests_passed: the test stand-in canDefend() ignored the plot and move() kept groups intact
